snippet.title: Laundromat 8 | Game Trailer
snippet.description:
Steam Page : https://store.steampowered.com/app/4880890/Laundromat_8/

You are trapped in an endlessly repeating laundromat. Observe your surroundings carefully, spot the anomalies, and choose Stop or Resume. Make the right calls, finish your laundry, and find your way home.
#psychologicalhorror #anomaly #steam
